title: ensemble-codesim: An Ensemble of Unsupervised Similarity Measures for Source Code Clone Detection (with the CodeSim toolkit)
description: An open toolkit and study for source code clone detection that combines more than twenty unsupervised similarity measures into a single, inspectable ensemble. The release includes the CodeSim Python package (one interface over textual, token, structural, learned, and behavioral measures, plus ensembles, evaluation metrics, dataset loaders, and a command-line interface) and a reproducible evaluation on BigCloneBench. Companion paper: Advanced Detection of Source Code Clones via an Ensemble of Unsupervised Similarity Measures (SWQD 2025).
